author: Sablinova
install_msg:
Thank you for installing GameDL!
Use `[p]gamedl <game name>` to search and extract SteamRIP download links.
name: GameDL
short: Search and extract SteamRIP direct download links.
description: Searches steamrip.com for PC games and extracts direct download links (Gofile, Buzzheavier, MegaDB, 1Fichier, FileDitch, etc.), file size, and version info with rich Discord embeds and interactive download buttons.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store end user data.
